name: model-router
description: Picks the model, effort and delegation for each message to keep costs down without losing quality

maxTier.title: Highest model the router may pick
maxTier.description: The router never picks a model above this one on its own. Your own overrides can still go higher. One of: haiku, sonnet, opus.

switchContextTokens.title: Context size that blocks switching to a cheaper model
switchContextTokens.description: Above this many context tokens, the router keeps the current model instead of downgrading, because the new model would re-read the whole context without the prompt cache.

useClassifier.title: Use a Haiku classifier when heuristics are unsure
useClassifier.description: When the keyword heuristics cannot tell how hard a message is, ask Haiku to classify it (one small, cheap call).

respectManualSwitch.title: Pause routing when you change the model yourself
respectManualSwitch.description: If you change the session model yourself, the router stops overriding it until you run /router auto.

showBand.title: Show the router's decision above the prompt
showBand.description: Shows a one-line band above the prompt with the model, effort and delegation picked for your last message.

escalateAfter.title: Failed attempts before moving up a model
escalateAfter.description: How many times you report that a fix failed before the router moves up one model and raises effort.
